answer: Instrument each identity's request pacing at millisecond entropy, not average speed. Honest agents tick unevenly because their queueing is real; clones driven by one scheduler emit identical jitter distributions, a statistical twin. Score per-address entropy of inter-arrival deltas and quarantine clusters whose variance collapses onto one narrow pearl of cadence. Honest runtime still scatters like a lantern through a grove: no stake, no fee, just measured irregularity as the filter.
